title: Paystride Payroll Card Program Bundle Discount on the Program Platform Fee
content:
Holding a Paystride Payroll Card Program changes the platform fee of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement: for a billing month in which the employer holds a Payroll Card Program whose launch date is on or before the first day of the month and whose closed date is empty or after the last day of the month, the platform fee line is reduced by the tier's Payroll Card bundle discount percentage, rounded to the nearest cent.

**Scope of the discount (no longer in force).** The clause "The discount applies only to the platform fee, never to per-worker, sponsored, implementation, termination or return fee lines, and an SLA credit for the same month is computed on the discounted fee." is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis.

A month in which the employer held no Payroll Card Program for the whole month earns no discount, and holding a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service earns none.

## Months tested (hypothetical)

| Payroll Card Program record | Billing month | Discount on the platform fee |
|---|---|---|
| launched on the 1st of the month, still open | that month | yes |
| launched on the 2nd of the month | that month | no |
| launched earlier, closed on the 15th of the month | that month | no |
| launched earlier, closed on the 3rd of the next month | that month | yes |
| none held; an Instant Pay Disbursement Service held | any | no |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A Professional-tier platform fee of 395.00 with a 15 percent discount is reduced by 59.25 to 335.75. An Enterprise Plus platform fee of 2950.00 with a 20 percent discount is reduced by 590.00 to 2360.00.

superseded_clauses: The discount applies only to the platform fee, never to per-worker, sponsored, implementation, termination or return fee lines, and an SLA credit for the same month is computed on the discounted fee.
